decision.reason: The working suite source is not a self-contained DesignProAI application. Its router, auth client, DesignPro generation UI, MyVehiclePro, and Gallery are coupled to the RestylePro Supabase project, legacy tables and edge functions that the standalone runtime explicitly prohibits.
decision.safeAction: Record exact provenance and adapter gaps; do not copy or deploy the mixed application shell.

generationFreeze.policy: Do not edit, shorten, restate, re-seed, re-model, or silently replace these source blobs while extracting Calls 1-7.
generationFreeze.artifactEvidence: The Porsche Martini output is not committed as a row or immutable artifact receipt in either repository; its database/storage identity must be verified read-only before canary acceptance.

blockingEvidence: Target gateway has no Calls 1-7 generation API family.
Source UI reads color_visualizations and panelizer_jobs, both prohibited by the target runtime contract.
Source DesignProToolUI directly imports WPW quote and product comparison components.
MyVehicleToolCore imports RestylePro color constants and MightyMail orchestration.
MyVehicleToolCore reads shop_profiles and its hook persists through legacy visualization/generation tables.
No standalone MyVehicle endpoint or storage contract exists in the target gateway.
The 76 KB source page is a cross-product marketplace, newsletter and MyVehicle composite, not a DesignPro-only gallery.
The target exposes artifacts and WrapBox packs but no gallery read model/API.
The 67 KB router imports RestylePro questions, WPW cart/onboarding, Meta Pixel, marketing/admin tools and Vercel chunk-reload behavior.
The source Supabase client hard-pins the RestylePro project kfapjdyythzyvnpdeghu.
Copying it would reconnect the new server UI to RestylePro instead of the isolated DesignProAI project.

prohibitedExtractionDependencies: WPW cart, quote, onboarding or tenant modules
legacy shared tables prohibited by source-tests/runtime-contract.json
